entry.title: Rumeli Hisarı

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: Inspected exterior tower picture confirms stepped roofless masonry crowns by the Bosphorus; the second picture informs stone/brick appearance only, with its interior excluded. Retained east/south wall, tower and courtyard geometry and standard viewer PMTiles set approximate location, scale and seaward orientation. The derivative omits the duplicated terrain patch, uses the same PMTiles sampler for all wall/tower-footing LODs and translates the old study datum to the21.351156683452786m PMTiles anchor datum. Tower floor pads retain a level rim above sampled coarse ground with bounded footings reaching it. Anchor 29.056189597,41.084874691; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 21.351156683452786m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
